quest:Loominadi1.name: Rhyming_is_Key!
quest:Loominadi1.description: Kill moonmen until they drop all the keys you need.

quest:Loominadi2.name: Uh,_Something_About_Vials?
quest:Loominadi2.description: Upgrade 13 Vials up to light-blue rarity or higher

quest:Loominadi3.name: Journey_to_the_Center_of_the_Blundermines
quest:Loominadi3.description: Reach the Ol' Straightaway mining area, with Plat and Dementia ore.

quest:Loominadi4.name: The_Mummy_of_Mystery
quest:Loominadi4.description: Find the biggest secret in all of YumYum Desert, and defeat it.

item:StoneZ1.name: Mystery_Upgrade_Stone_I
item:StoneZ1.description: Drag onto any Equip to apply. Success Chance; 100% Uses up 1 slots only if Successful. WARNING:Mystery Stat has a chance to be Negative, and reduce stats!

item:PremiumGem.name: Gem
item:PremiumGem.description: Hold down to add these gems to your account. You can then spend them in the Gem Shop!

item:ExpBalloon1.name: Small_Experience_Balloon
item:ExpBalloon1.description: Hold down to gain EXP in the skill that's displayed in the corner of your screen. If you're in a town, you will gain EXP in the town skill. The amount of EXP you get is based on your skill's Lv.

item:Quest18.name: Loomi's_Room_Key
item:Quest18.description: A key to a door, but there are still more! Why so many? They were on sale for a penny!

item:PureWater.name: Distilled_Water
item:PureWater.description: The full filtration process also involves filtering the diamonds through a vat of diamonds before using those filtered diamonds to filter the water! If only they'd filter their filtration process through diamonds so this item description wouldn't be so long.

item:StoneZ2.name: Mystery_Upgrade_Stone_II
item:StoneZ2.description: Drag onto any Equip to apply. Success Chance; 60% Uses up 1 slots only if Successful. WARNING:Mystery Stat has a chance to be Negative, and reduce stats!

item:Quest37.name: Silver_Antique
item:Quest37.description: An old lady pawned it off to the bazaar claiming it was some 'ancient artifact of the pharoah King Doot'. It's probably just scrap metal, doubt it's even real silver. Would make for a decent Necklace!

item:NPCtoken24.name: Loominadi_Token
item:NPCtoken24.description: Proof that you completed all of Loominadi's quests! Hold down to add to your token bag found in Storage Info. DONT SELL THIS ITEM

item:Weight8.name: Literal_Elephant
item:Weight8.description: Hold down to add this accessory to it to your fishing toolkit, where it can be accessed by all characters!

item:Timecandy5.name: 24_HR_Time_Candy
item:Timecandy5.description: An entire day, just like that! Hold down to instantly get 24 Hour of AFK Gains.

pageProps.seoDescription: Loominadi is a Legends of Idleon NPC: quest reward, 4 quests.
